description: Who can see and use a channel: @everyone, each role that can see it (with how many members hold it, whether they can post or join, and any powers there), members with their own overwrite, and the owner. With include_members, also checks every member one by one, which is exact where roles combine. Read only. For the overwrites as set on the channel, use get_channel_permissions; for one member across every channel, get_member_access.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

include_members.description: Check each member and list who can see it (up to 100 names). Needs the Server Members intent.

name: get_channel_access
title: Get channel access
